summary: Complete frontend testing of Xbox 360 Dashboard replica - Iteration 14. Tested friend profile cards, Xbox 360 keyboard-triggered chat input, party invite platform split, and dashboard card removal. All 16 requested features verified successfully.

issues: Some game cover images fail to load (Wikipedia URLs blocked) - Spider-Man, Bionic Commando, Halo 3, Gears of War 2 covers show broken/placeholder. Red Dead Redemption cover loads correctly.

passed_tests: Dashboard has exactly 4 cards: GAMES, FAVORITES, SYSTEM SETTINGS, ACHIEVEMENTS (Themes/Marketplace removed)
Dashboard header has no 'Sign In' text - only static avatar circle
Guide opens via data-testid='guide-home-button'
Guide profile row shows static avatar - no 'Sign In' text
Guide Friends → Xbox Live → Click friend shows Xbox 360 profile card
Profile card displays: name (MasterChief117), platform (Xbox Live), status (online), activity (Playing Halo 3)
Profile card has 'Invite to Party' button with X controller hint
Profile card has 'Invite to Game' with Coming Soon badge and Y controller hint
Profile footer shows X Party and Y Game controller hints when viewing profile
Back button on profile returns to friends list
Guide Friends → Discord → Click friend shows Discord profile card
Messages → Xbox Live → Click conversation shows chat with keyboard trigger input
Chat input trigger shows 'Type a message...' with A button hint
Clicking chat trigger opens Xbox 360 on-screen keyboard
Typing on keyboard and pressing Done sends chat message
Parties → Create Party → Invite More shows Xbox Live / Discord platform picker
Invite More → Xbox Live shows Xbox friends to invite
Invite More → Discord shows Discord friends to invite
Inviting a friend changes button to 'Invited'
Back navigation works at all levels including profile and invite platform views
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Friend profile card (viewingProfile state) correctly shows platform, status, activity
Controller hints X/Y properly displayed on profile actions
Chat input trigger correctly calls onOpenKeyboard callback
Party invite flow uses invitePlatform state for Xbox Live / Discord split
Footer hints dynamically update when viewing profile (shows X Party, Y Game)
mainCards array correctly has only 4 cards (library, favorites, settings, achievements)
